conventions.conventionDifference: Convention channels: CN+REL minus CN+S direction using the same JPL kernel, TT/TDB and frame; Moon zero. Separate model sensitivity, not engine error or a correction to aggregate maxima.
conventions.correction: JPL Moon NONE; Sun Mercury Venus CN+REL with no deflection; Earth center 399; NAIF periodic TT/TDB
conventions.distance: Engine calc apparent geocentric light path in au converted to km minus JPL converged light path; geometric Moon. calc uses binary64 JD = TT days since J2000 + 2451545; chart uses original millisecond instant.
conventions.frame: IAU2006 bias/precession and unadjusted IAU2000B true ecliptic/equinox of date
conventions.input: Synthetic TT; uniform sphere; random house systems; half-open 1800-01-01 to 2200-01-01
conventions.limitations: Engine backdated-observer aberration, light-time, frame and truncated TT/TDB differences remain in residuals. No solar deflection or moving-body ray integration; convention delta isolates only the selected aberration models.

DE440.reason: Verified exact Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus and Earth center chains cover the padded TT sampling interval.

DE441.reason: The requested TT sampling span lies within full DE440 coverage; no DE441 sampling interval is requested.

conventions.residual: JPL channels: engine minus relativistic JPL direction in arcseconds; distance in km
conventions.tolerance: 60 arcseconds and 10000 km screening only; fixed before pilot, not accuracy bounds

exclusions: Reproduction: node crosscheck/tools/campaign.mjs crosscheck/runtime/p4-pilot.json all, then report. Specification: {"name":"phase2-pilot","profile":"phase2","kernel":"de440","seed":"synthetic-phase2-pilot-v1","total":64,"shards":2}. Preserve external Swiss environment selectors if enabled.
Only exact Sun/Moon/Mercury/Venus centers compared; no other planets, houses, nodes, angles, speeds or topocentric checks. No UTC/UT1 validation.
Full DE440 covers the entire requested TT span; DE441 has no selected interval or measurements. Inactive group and missing exact-center verdicts are unsupported, never zero-error observations.

JPL residuals use Moon NONE and other exact centers CN+REL without deflection. They retain backdated-observer aberration, light-time, frame and periodic TT/TDB model differences. Convention channels isolate CN+REL minus CN+S on the same independent states, not total model error.

Distances use binary64 TT Julian dates in calc, which can round relative to natalChart millisecond inputs; JPL uses TT seconds converted to TDB. Distance maxima are in km and angular maxima in arcseconds.
Swiss.positions is the legacy unavailable channel; optional per-body Swiss channels carry actual measurements. Fallback/error/unsupported verdicts contain no residuals.
Sample maxima are not unsampled bounds; no throughput guarantee. Command records report invocation; reproduction command above runs all shards from scratch with identical inputs.
